summary:
The story is mainly about the two probes that were sent to Mars to gather information about that planet. I wrote it as fiction about two brothers who met before the Phoenix mission and promised to meet again, but sadly, that never happened.

They became heroes because they managed to collect information about the planet and determine whether or not it is habitable.
details: The real missions of NASA's space probes on Mars (Phoenix and InSight) are personified as twin brothers separated by time, successfully combining scientific outreach, accurate historical data, and an emotional narrative about perseverance and space exploration that seeks to inspire audiences in STEM fields through design tools, documentary research, and artificial intelligence support.
